scoring_justification: Both headline metrics (raw relative optical performance R_Fe/Pb and Brewster performance factor R_B) are recomputed by the checker from the agent's raw absorption coefficient and refractive index CSV files. The hidden solar irradiance spectrum and interface refractive indices are bundled inline; no trust in agent-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Solar irradiance spectrum (310-830 nm) for optical correlation coefficient
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from SORCE average irradiance (paper reference [64]), simplified to piecewise linear as used in reference solver
hidden_assets.generation_method: Constructed piecewise linear mimicking SORCE shape; integrated into checker code inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Necessary to recompute C(p) as defined in paper; spectrum shape publicly known but not required by agent. Hidden spectrum is used to verify agent's spectra produce the paper's reported ratio.

hidden_assets.purpose: Refractive indices of TiO2 and spiro-OMeTAD at 600 nm
hidden_assets.source_provenance: TiO2 n=2.5 from Shannon et al. (2002); spiro-OMeTAD n=1.7 from Filipic et al. (2015), as cited in paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded in checker; values match literature used in paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Required to compute Brewster angle factor as defined in paper; not publicly required by agent.

outputs.description: Absorption coefficient spectra for MAFeI3 and MAPbI3. The checker recomputes the optical correlation coefficient ratio R_Fe/Pb from these data, using a hidden solar irradiance spectrum (310-830 nm), and scores whether the ratio meets a preset threshold derived from the literature.

Refractive index spectra for MAFeI3 and MAPbI3. The checker recomputes the Brewster angle performance factor R_B at a specified wavelength using hidden refractive indices of TiO2 and spiro-OMeTAD, and scores whether R_B meets a preset threshold derived from the literature.

output_contract.notes: The solving agent does not need to compute the optical correlation coefficient or Brewster angles; those are computed by the checker from the submitted data. All non-public data (solar irradiance, interface refractive indices) are bundled with the checker and not required by the agent.

steps.description: Recompute optical correlation coefficient ratio R_Fe/Pb from absorption coefficients and hidden solar irradiance.
steps.scoring_rule: If recomputed ratio_R >= 0.51, score=1.0; else if >= 0.30 score = (ratio_R - 0.30)/0.21; else 0.

steps.description: Recompute Brewster angle performance factor R_B at 600 nm from refractive indices and hidden TiO2/spiro indices.
steps.scoring_rule: If recomputed R_B >= 1.30, score=1.0; else if >= 1.0 score = (R_B - 1.0)/0.30; else 0.
